findings.text: the changed declarations move s16 to `done`, but s16's own record says otherwise: its worker wrote "the 111-file importer pair ... adds 6 stale no-review assertions in 3 fenced-out test files, recorded for the coordinator scope repair" (plan.html:236) and the review of the landed head closed with "importer requirement remains unmet with six fixture failures requiring coordinator scope repair" (plan.html:233), so the close comment's "Review 115 of 120 with no finding" (plan.html:227) states the opposite of the stored review and s16's done-when clause "Importers add no failure against the base" reads met when six added failure ids are on record and no repair is. A reader or a rollup counting s16 as landed cannot tell that the section's gate did not reach its own bar, and no open followup names the six stale assertions as owed work

findings.reason: the fixture cannot be built without first deciding which field the unresolvable commit occupies and what releases the run afterwards, so a node dispatched on this text would either construct a case §5 already makes releasable or implement a withholding with no exit.
findings.text: s18's third fixture, "one merged whose manifest cites an unresolvable commit beside its real head", is turned by the deliverable (plan.html:160) into "one obligation naming which, and nothing of it is removed", and no clause says what clears it: the only parties who could resolve a commit that does not exist are gone, so this run is left in exactly the fourteen-run state §18 exists to end, holding a pointer and a duty with no verb. The class also collides with §5, which is declared `done`: §5 repairs an echoed base revision from the run's pointer and records it as a repaired echo that "does not block", which is the same manifest-value-the-tool-issued condition this fixture describes — a worker cannot tell whether the run is released under §5's repair or frozen by s18's obligation. The plan is likewise silent on which manifest field the citation is: a base echo §5 already repairs, or a commits entry the ledger row's head selection (`promoted_revision` first, then the last non-empty commit) would otherwise carry
